central-africa.title: Afríka ya Katikati
central-africa.description: Kongó-Kinshasa, Kamerun, Tshad, Repibiki ya Afríka ya Káti, Gabɔ́, Kongó-Brazzaville, Ginɛ́-Ekwatorial, Angola mpe Zambia — Kinshasa, Luanda, Douala, Yaoundé, N'Djamena, Lusaka; etando ya ebale Kongó mpe Rift Albertin.

south-central-us.title: Sidi ya katikati ya Ameriki
south-central-us.description: Texas, Oklahoma, Arkansas, Louisiana, Kentucky, Tennessee, Mississippi mpe Alabama — Houston, Dallas, San Antonio, Austin, Oklahoma City, Tulsa, Little Rock, New Orleans, Louisville, Nashville, Memphis, Jackson mpe Birmingham.

west-polynesia.title: Samoa mpe Tonga
west-polynesia.description: Samoa, Samoa ya Ameriki, Tonga, Niue, Tokelau, mpe Wallis-ná-Futuna — Apia, Pago Pago, Nukuʻalofa, Alofi mpe Mata-Utu; Upolu, Savaiʻi, Tutuila mpe bisanga ya Tonga.

mariana-islands.title: Guam mpe Bisanga Mariana ya Nɔ́rdi
mariana-islands.description: Guam mpe Bisanga Mariana ya Nɔ́rdi — Hagåtña, Tamuning, Dededo, Saipan, Tinian mpe Rota.

greenland.title: Groenland
greenland.description: Groenland — Nuuk, Sisimiut, Ilulissat, Qaqortoq mpe Tasiilaq; etando ya glasi, fjord ya glasi ya Ilulissat mpe ba-fjord ya sudi.

bermuda.title: Bermuda
bermuda.description: Bermuda — Hamilton, St. George’s mpe Royal Naval Dockyard, ba-paroisse ya esanga mpe mabeke na yango ya zelo ya langi ya rose.

belarus.title: Bielorisi
belarus.description: Bielorisi — Minsk, Gomel, Mogilev, Vitebsk, Grodno mpe Brest; zamba ya Belovezhskaya Pushcha mpe bitima ya Polesia.

channel-islands.title: Bisanga Anglo-Normandes
channel-islands.description: Jersey, Guernsey, Alderney, Sark mpe Herm — St Helier, St Peter Port mpe Gorey.

faroe-islands.title: Bisanga Féroé
faroe-islands.description: Bisanga Féroé — Tórshavn, Klaksvík, Runavík mpe bisanga zómi na mwambe, mboka na yango, ba-tinele mpe mabanga milai ya libongo.

svalbard.title: Svalbard
svalbard.description: Svalbard mpe Jan Mayen — Longyearbyen, Barentsburg mpe Ny-Ålesund; ba-glasye mpe ba-fjord ya Spitsbergen.

malta.title: Malta
malta.description: Malta, Gozo mpe Comino — Valletta, Sliema, St Julian’s, Mdina, Victoria mpe Bingumba Misáto.

madagascar-islands.title: Madagasikari mpe Bisanga ya Mbú ya Indien
madagascar-islands.description: Madagasikari, Komori, Mayotte, Réunion, Morisi mpe Seyshele — Antananarivo, Toamasina, Moroni, Mamoudzou, Saint-Denis, Port Louis mpe Victoria.

sudan.title: Sudani
sudan.description: Sudani — Khartoum, Omdurman, Port-Soudan, Kassala, El Obeid mpe Nyala; esika Nil ya Bule mpe Nil ya Pɛmbɛ ekutanaka mpe ba-piramidi ya Meroë.

cabo-verde.title: Kapo Vɛrdɛ
cabo-verde.description: Kapo Vɛrdɛ — Praia, Mindelo, Santa Maria mpe bisanga zómi, banda Santo Antão kino Brava.

sao-tome-principe.title: Sao Tomé mpe Prínsipe
sao-tome-principe.description: Sao Tomé mpe Prínsipe — São Tomé, Santo António mpe zamba ya mbula mpe mabeke ya bisanga mibale.

saint-helena.title: Sainte-Hélène, Ascension mpe Tristan da Cunha
saint-helena.description: Sainte-Hélène, Esanga Ascension mpe Tristan da Cunha — Jamestown, Georgetown mpe Edinburgh of the Seven Seas.

bangladesh.title: Bangladɛsi
bangladesh.description: Bangladɛsi — Dhaka, Chittagong, Khulna, Rajshahi, Sylhet mpe Cox’s Bazar; Sundarbans mpe delta ya Gange–Brahmapoutre.

sri-lanka-maldives.title: Sri Lanka mpe Maldives
sri-lanka-maldives.description: Sri Lanka mpe Maldives — Colombo, Kandy, Galle, Jaffna, Trincomalee, Anuradhapura mpe Malé; etúká ya bangomba, Sigiriya mpe ba-atolle.

vietnam.title: Vietnami
vietnam.description: Vietnami — Hanoi, Engumba Ho Chi Minh, Da Nang, Hai Phong, Hue, Hoi An mpe Can Tho; Libéu ya Ha Long mpe delta ya Mekong.

philippines.title: Filipine
philippines.description: Filipine — Manila, Quezon City, Cebu, Davao, Iloilo, Baguio mpe Zamboanga; Luzon, Visayas, Mindanao mpe Palawan.

indonesia.title: Indonezi mpe Timor-Leste
indonesia.description: Indonezi mpe Timor-Leste — Jakarta, Surabaya, Bandung, Medan, Yogyakarta, Denpasar, Makassar mpe Dili; Java, Sumatra, Bali, Borneo, Sulawesi mpe Papua.

malaysia-singapore-brunei.title: Malɛzi, Singapur mpe Brunei
malaysia-singapore-brunei.description: Malɛzi, Singapur mpe Brunei — Kuala Lumpur, Singapur, George Town, Johor Bahru, Malacca, Kota Kinabalu, Kuching mpe Bandar Seri Begawan.

myanmar.title: Myanmar
myanmar.description: Myanmar — Yangon, Mandalay, Naypyidaw, Bagan, Mawlamyine mpe Laki Inle; lobwaku ya Irrawaddy mpe bangomba ya Shan.

cambodia-laos.title: Kambodja mpe Laos
cambodia-laos.description: Kambodja mpe Laos — Phnom Penh, Siem Reap mpe Angkor, Battambang, Vientiane, Luang Prabang mpe Pakse; ebale Mekong mpe Tonlé Sap.

colombia.title: Kolombi
colombia.description: Kolombi — Bogotá, Medellín, Cali, Barranquilla, Cartagena mpe Bucaramanga; Andes, libongo ya Karaibe mpe Amazone.

venezuela.title: Venezwela
venezuela.description: Venezwela — Caracas, Maracaibo, Valencia, Barquisimeto, Mérida mpe Ciudad Bolívar; Salto Ángel, ebale Orinoco mpe Isla Margarita.

peru.title: Peru
peru.description: Peru — Lima, Arequipa, Cusco, Trujillo, Iquitos mpe Puno; Machu Picchu, Laki Titicaca mpe Lobwaku Mosantu.

ecuador.title: Ekwatɛ́lɛ
ecuador.description: Ekwatɛ́lɛ — Quito, Guayaquil, Cuenca, Manta mpe Baños; Nzela ya Bangomba ya Mɔ́tɔ, Amazone mpe Bisanga Galápagos.

bolivia.title: Bolivi
bolivia.description: Bolivi — La Paz, El Alto, Santa Cruz, Cochabamba, Sucre mpe Potosí; Laki Titicaca mpe Salar de Uyuni.

chile.title: Shili
chile.description: Shili — Santiago, Valparaíso, Concepción, Antofagasta, La Serena mpe Punta Arenas; Atacama, etúká ya ba-laki, Patagonia mpe Esanga ya Pâques.

paraguay-uruguay.title: Paraguay mpe Uruguay
paraguay-uruguay.description: Paraguay mpe Uruguay — Asunción, Ciudad del Este, Encarnación, Montevideo, Punta del Este mpe Colonia del Sacramento.

guianas.title: Ba-Guyane
guianas.description: Guyana, Suriname mpe Guyane ya Falansé — Georgetown, Paramaribo, Cayenne mpe Kourou; Mai-ma-kokita ya Kaieteur mpe zamba ya mbula ya Guiana Shield.

falklands.title: Bisanga Malouines
falklands.description: Bisanga Malouines (Falkland) — Stanley, Goose Green mpe bisanga ya East Falkland mpe West Falkland.

australia.title: Ositrali
australia.description: Ositrali — Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Perth, Adelaide, Hobart, Darwin mpe Canberra; Grande Barrière de corail, Uluru mpe Outback.

new-zealand.title: Zelandi ya Sika
new-zealand.description: Zelandi ya Sika — Auckland, Wellington, Christchurch, Hamilton, Dunedin mpe Queenstown; Alpes ya Sudi, Fiordland mpe Rotorua.

british-columbia.title: Kolombi-Britanike
british-columbia.description: Kolombi-Britanike — Vancouver, Victoria, Kelowna, Kamloops, Prince George mpe Whistler; Bangomba ya Libongo, Esanga Vancouver mpe Okanagan.

canadian-prairies.title: Ba-Prairie ya Kanada
canadian-prairies.description: Alberta, Saskatchewan mpe Manitoba — Calgary, Edmonton, Winnipeg, Saskatoon, Regina mpe Banff; Rocheuses, ba-prairie mpe Churchill na libongo ya Baie d’Hudson.

ontario.title: Ontario
ontario.description: Ontario — Toronto, Ottawa, Mississauga, Hamilton, London, Kingston mpe Thunder Bay; Mai-ma-kokita ya Niagara, Ba-Laki Minene mpe Parc Algonquin.

quebec.title: Kebeki
quebec.description: Kebeki — Montréal, Engumba Kebeki, Laval, Gatineau, Sherbrooke mpe Saguenay; ebale Saint-Laurent, Laurentides mpe péninsule ya Gaspésie.

atlantic-canada.title: Kanada ya Atlantiki
atlantic-canada.description: Nouveau-Brunswick, Nouvelle-Écosse, Île-du-Prince-Édouard, mpe Terre-Neuve-et-Labrador — Halifax, St. John’s, Moncton, Saint John, Fredericton mpe Charlottetown; Cabot Trail mpe Baie de Fundy.

northern-canada.title: Nɔ́rdi ya Kanada
northern-canada.description: Yukon, Territoires du Nord-Ouest mpe Nunavut — Whitehorse, Yellowknife, Iqaluit, Dawson City mpe Inuvik; bisanga ya Arktiki mpe ebale Mackenzie.

hong-kong-macau.title: Hong Kong mpe Macao
hong-kong-macau.description: Hong Kong mpe Macao — Esanga Hong Kong, Kowloon, Nouveaux Territoires, Lantau mpe péninsule ya Macao, Taipa mpe Coloane.
